plan: Model the workspace as a validated recursive composite: workspace/section/group containers and note/reference leaves.
Use one deterministic depth-first traversal for aggregation, marker collection, and outline rendering, with kind-specific leaf behavior.
Implement moves as preflight validation followed by a single remove/insert mutation, preserving atomicity on failure.
mechanisms: Deep-copied canonical dictionary tree with recursive schema and globally unique-ID validation
Recursive composite traversal in list order
Kind-dispatched summary contributions for notes and references
Marker removal before regex word counting
Set aggregation plus lexicographic sorting for unresolved identifiers
Transactional move preflight with container, bounds, and cycle checks

trace.source_relation: atomic: single parcel -> note or reference
trace.target_mechanism: Kind-dispatched leaf behavior for word-count and unresolved-marker summaries

trace.source_relation: group: crate of shippable units -> section or nested group
trace.target_mechanism: Recursive composite containers whose item lists may contain leaves or further containers

trace.source_relation: operation: weighing, label collection, or manifest traversal -> word count, marker collection, or outline rendering
trace.target_mechanism: Shared deterministic recursive traversal used by all three operations

trace.source_relation: containment_rule: allowed nesting and no-cycle rule -> valid-location and no-cycle rule
trace.target_mechanism: Destination-kind validation and subtree cycle detection before mutation
Transactional move preflight followed by one remove/insert mutation
